findings.evidence: MyApplication.kt initializes FirebaseAnalytics to log app interactions and usage telemetry off-device. Analytics collection is gated by the hasAcceptedPrivacy preference, which is disclosed and opted into via the WelcomeScreen.kt AlertDialog ('Mave also collects app interactions and analytics data').
findings.recommendation: Declare collection of App Interactions in the Google Play Data Safety form for Analytics and App Functionality purposes.

findings.evidence: Camera permissions and image/vision frame processing in MainActivity.kt, player-controls.ts, and ChatScreen-D4g5_Ezi.js send photo and camera data off-device to Gemini Live API for AI music generation. This collection is disclosed and consented to via WelcomeScreen.kt AlertDialog ('Mave collects and transmits camera and microphone data to enable real-time AI music generation').
findings.recommendation: Declare collection and off-device transmission of Photos and Videos in the Google Play Data Safety form under App Functionality.
